description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing work experience information of an employee in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for normalization, retrieving work experience data, and mapping fields for reporting purposes.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: A DTO class for employee work experience details, supporting conversion to array and field mapping for report generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WorkExperience DTO with a given employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the work experience data for the employee into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods in the Employee and Decorator classes.
